title: Changelog
subtitle: How the State #2807 event tools have changed over time.
v221a: Leaders can add players to a rally straight from the SVS players list.
v221docs: New help guides for Frost Dragon Tyrant and SVS (including how to read the battle plan), and updated guides for Minister and for organisers, in every language. Look for "How does it work?" on each event page.
v220a: Sign up for SVS: pick the battle hours you will be online, each troop camp's level with T10 or T11, and whether you can join Discord voice chat.
v220b: Your troop details are shared between Frost Dragon Tyrant and SVS: fill them in once and the other form is ready for you.
v220c: Leaders can now add players who didn't sign up, in every event.
v220d: SVS battle plans: leaders can share a plan so everyone sees their role, heroes, troop ratio and timings. Type your name in "Find me" to jump to your place.
v210a: Pages load faster, especially on phones: you now download only the screens and the language you use.
v210b: Clearer dates and times: shown in the timezone you pick at the top, with the month written out and no seconds.
v210c: New “Where do I find my player ID?” tip on the first step of every sign-up form.
v210d: Better protection against abuse: rapid repeated look-ups and submissions are slowed down, and the site has extra browser security.
v210e: Organisers can rename any round, including past ones. The Event Management link is now a small link at the bottom of event pages.
v200a: Minister Management is now a hub for state events: Minister, Frost Dragon Tyrant, with SVS and Tundra Arms League coming soon.
v200b: New Frost Dragon Tyrant sign-up: a step-by-step form for your time windows, roles, and each troop camp’s level and tier.
v200c: Your details are saved against your player ID and shared between events, so you only type them once.
v200d: Built for phones: a compact header, Back and Next buttons always in reach, and bigger buttons to tap.
v200e: Opens in your phone’s language automatically. Your language, timezone and theme are remembered.
v200f: Furnace level is now a dropdown: Fire Crystal levels FC10 to FC1 first, then 30 to 1.
v200g: For leaders: one Event Management area for every event, with guides, and Tyrant filters by camp level, tier, time window and alliance.
v200h: Safer admin sign-in, and avatars removed from assignment cards after the game stopped providing them.
v140a: Three colour themes with a switcher, remembered on your device.
v140b: Clearer labels on the speedup and fire crystal fields.
v140c: Schedule days now appear in weekday order.
v140d: Polish added to the supported languages.
v140e: Reduced motion is respected when your device asks for it.
v130a: Removed the automatic player lookup after the game changed its service.
v130b: Players now type their own game name when applying.
v120a: Admins can choose how time slots are laid out across the day.
v120b: The slot either side of midnight is handled as one shared position.
v120c: Unassigned players are listed as soon as a day is opened.
v110a: Alliance tags shown next to player names throughout.
v110b: Excel export covering every day in one workbook.
v110c: Player avatars and furnace levels on assignment cards.
v100b: Automatic assignment based on contribution points.
v100c: Drag and drop editing of the schedule.
